name: ColorManagedDisplaySettings
description: Color management specific to display device

props.name: Display
props.description: Display name. For viewing, this is the display device that will be emulated by limiting the gamut and HDR colors. For image and video output, this is the display space used for writing.

props.name: Display Emulation
props.description: Control how images in the chosen display are mapped to the physical display

items.name: Off
items.description: Directly output image as produced by OpenColorIO. This is not correct in general, but may be used when the system configuration and actual display device is known to match the chosen display

items.name: Automatic
items.description: Display images consistent with most other applications, to preview images and video for export. A best effort is made to emulate the chosen display on the actual display device.
